conventions.expected: Weekdays between the first record and today. Weekends carry no fix and are refused by the freshness guard by design, so they are not gaps.
conventions.explained: A gap is explained when a skip record says why no forecast was published. An unexplained gap is one nothing survives from — the job died, never ran, or was never scheduled — and is the weaker case.
conventions.frozen: A forecast freezes once its shortest horizon could have elapsed. Frozen forecasts may not be rewritten; live ones may, and git carries every version of both.
